source_of_truth: Product Portfolio v1.1 (go.napster.com/napster-portfolio, 16 Jul 2026) + CPO rulings 20 Jul 2026

global.security_line: Napster is SOC 2 Type II audited; identity and encryption align to the Microsoft stack.
global.security_note: SOC 2 Type II attestation confirmed real by CPO. Never write 'SOC 2 controls', 'SOC 2*', or 'SOC 2 certified'. Final wording subject to legal confirmation of report scope/period — if legal amends, change it HERE only.

marketplace_canon.rule: No blanket 'Available in Microsoft Marketplace' statement is true at company level. State per-product status only.

global.endorsement_rule: Never imply Microsoft endorsement, co-sell incentive, or MACC eligibility beyond the per-product status above.

napster-app.name: Napster App
napster-app.platform_note: Android is included. Never ship 'iOS · Mac · Web'.
napster-app.free_tier_claim: UNRESOLVED — do not write '$0' or 'free to try' until CPO documents a trial

napster-view.name: Napster View
napster-view.pricing: $99 one-time, or free with any Napster App annual plan
napster-view.pricing_note: The free-with-annual bundle is CONFIRMED REAL (CPO, 20 Jul 2026). Portfolio page needs updating to match — collateral is correct.

napster-agent.name: Napster Agent
napster-agent.pricing: $99/mo (one role, 50 hrs) · $249/mo (up to three roles, 150 shared hrs) · Boost $20/$50/$100
napster-agent.pricing_rule: Flat package model. NEVER 'usage-based' or 'per-hour' — that is the API's model, and confusing them is explicitly warned against in the portfolio.
napster-agent.channels: Website first; phone/contact-center via API or telephony partner — not a default channel

napster-api.name: Napster API
napster-api.pricing: $0.60/hr bring-your-own-agent or bring-your-own-model · $3.50/hr Napster brings everything

napster-pulse.name: Napster Pulse
napster-pulse.status: In build. Public beta 10/15 — do NOT print the date in external collateral.
napster-pulse.screenshot_rule: Synthetic participants only (e.g. Maya Alvarez, maya@example.com). Never internal employees, @napster.com addresses, or transcripts naming internal tools.

napster-station.name: Napster Station
napster-station.pricing: $499/mo bundle (device + software + usage), 12-month commitment, usage included
napster-station.hardware: Countertop device on a motion base that turns to greet customers. NOT 'transparent display', NOT 'runs on the customer's own hardware'.
napster-station.url: napster.com — never napster.com/developer on Station collateral

napster-for-work.name: Napster for Work
napster-for-work.pricing: Team $20 Standard / $100 Premium per seat/mo · Enterprise $20/seat/mo + $5/hr pooled
napster-for-work.image_rule: Use work-crew imagery. Never the consumer finance screenshot ('Plan any money move').
